baseline.gap: Ordinary close restored its scalar ID on accepted failure and enclosing Drop could submit again; accepted wait was unbounded. Reactor already used a consuming close owner.

implementation.owner: Private SocketLease retains the exact remote selector and original service connection together. take_closing moves it once; original OwnedSocket is empty. ClosingSocket retains PendingCall before the lease. No raw adoption or cleanup reconstruction.
implementation.admission: Both deadlines captured together before submission. Only explicit QUEUE_FULL rejection retries; bounded backoff clips to both original remaining budgets. Queue admission has no readiness source. Final rejection returns its actual IPC error before acceptance.
implementation.unstarted_retention: Finisher forgets the complete terminal driver without field destructors, recursion or another close. Runtime fields own no heap allocation, accepted kernel grant, request memory or loan. Remote socket and original server charge may remain while the domain lives. No cleanup, refund, custody or recovery/retry owner.
implementation.accepted: One PendingCall::wait_timeout with original remaining budget. Existing checked runtime/kernel wait reparks on unrelated wakes. No new watchdog capability or polling adapter. Deadline exhaustion, timeout and observation/wait-admission/service/malformed result abort with close owner live; no ID restoration or replay.
implementation.failure_distinction: Failure::Deadline and Failure::Observation(SocketError) preserve wait-admission rejection (RESOURCE_LIMIT) and observation/service/invalid-result errors separately. A terminal runtime observation may already have consumed its pending grant; containing close lease stays retained.
implementation.receipt: Unchanged OP_CLOSE 8: Started=0 / Unavailable=1, without attachments. CQ poll and borrowing wait share one observer. Completed pending owner disposes before lease. No physical-release, peer-delivery, earlier-business rollback or charge-refund proof.
implementation.drop: Explicit close and ordinary Drop invoke the same consuming driver once. Drop ignores final unstarted error; accepted uncertainty aborts. Still blocking; requested wait budget is not syscall-return or whole-parent shutdown latency proof.
implementation.scope: Existing C18 family, no new root, pin, registry or recovery owner. Userspace path adds no guards/IRQ manipulation. Broader parent destructor, TLS erasure and shutdown pressure qualification remains open.
